mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals central bank easing, lowering discount rates and increasing present-value of future equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a risk-off reaction, compressing discount rates and reducing the present value of equity cash flows, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate for 3 consecutive months signals central bank easing, lowering discount rates and increasing the present value of future equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in employment (PAYEMS) exceeding 20,000 jobs signals labor market strength, which reduces recession risk and boosts investor confidence, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in unemployment (UNRATE) exceeding 6.5% signals labor market stress, which raises recession risk and compresses discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in employment (PAYEMS) exceeding 30,000 jobs for 3 consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which reduces recession risk and boosts investor confidence, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
